_note: Chat provider for the floating 'Talk to Sofía / Habla con Sofía' button. "native" = in-page Sofía widget (contact-widget.js + dialog). "ghl" = GoHighLevel/LeadConnector chat widget, loaded only on the first click (ghl-chat.js). Revert the trial by setting provider to "native". Widget colors/texts are set in the GHL dashboard; ghl-chat.js restyles the widget like the native Sofía dialog (palette variables + a sheet in its open shadow roots) and overrides the agent (Sofía, "S" avatar; `subtitle` is ours, shown under the name) and every text below per page language (`texts.shared` + `texts.en|es`; `fields` = form labels by GHL fieldKey; `labels` = GHL built-in labels via its documented localizeWidget(labels, locale); `options` = display labels for the procedure picklist, whose submitted values stay the CRM values). See CONTACT-WIDGET.md.
